crossRefs.note: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like…
The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and…
For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of…

translations.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
translations.asv: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.
